_comment: Lasing basic test: 1um n=1.5 guide -> 10um ISOTROPIC dye-doped n=1.5 reservoir -> 1um n=1.5 guide. Gaussian pulse at 500nm from the left of guide_1; input/output 1Ddft sensors mid-guide; atom-level (concentration) sensor across the reservoir.

reservoir._comment: Isotropic dye-doped medium: uniform n=1.5, no LC constants, no relaxation, no lc_fields.npz; gain via the sted block, now genuinely PUMP-DRIVEN (see sted.N1_0/N3_0 below) via source_pump instead of pre-inverted.

sted._comment: 4-level dye starting in the GROUND state (N1_0=30, N3_0=0) -- source_pump (Ez, absorption line lbdA=0.45) must genuinely drive population 1->4->3 to build any inversion, instead of the old pre-inverted N3_0=30/N1_0=0 shortcut that left the pump with nothing to do.

source_1._comment: Plain (non-beam) Gaussian-envelope PULSE at 500nm injected at the LEFT edge of guide_1 -- switched 2026-07-24 from a focused gaussianbeam(exact2d=true) because that beam type's amplitude is a NO-OP by design (confirmed against real MEEP's own GaussianBeam2DSource.get_fields: it normalizes by dividing by a norm computed from the SAME amplitude-scaled field, canceling |E0| entirely -- only phase/direction survive), which silently broke the amplitude sweep. This plain source_type genuinely scales with amplitude. start_time=100.0 delays the pulse so it arrives AFTER the continuous pump (source_pump) has already built up substantial population inversion, to probe the actual gain rather than launching signal and pump simultaneously from a cold, uninverted medium. amplitude switched to a 2-element list 2026-07-25 (per user request) -- return_quadrosource/_strip_sources splits the size.y=10.0 extent into n_strips=2 equal 5.0-unit-tall independent-amplitude point sources, giving data_gen/generate_amplitude_sweep_data.py a real multi-channel input for capacity/nonlinearity characterization instead of the degenerate n_strips=1 scalar case.

source_pump._comment: Uniform 2D-area CW pump filling the reservoir's own footprint (not a guided line source like source_1) at the dye's absorption line lbdA=0.45 -- Ez polarization, orthogonal to source_1's guided Ey signal at the emission line lbdE=0.55, so pump and probe don't directly interfere in the FDTD fields. Drives real N1->N3 population transfer from a genuine ground-state start (sted.N1_0=30/N3_0=0). amplitude=200 (2026-07-24, per user request) -- between amp=100 (gradual buildup, ~35-57% inversion over 100-200 units) and amp=1000 (near-instant ~98% saturation by t~20), so this should show an intermediate, still-visible buildup curve.

conc_monitor._comment: Atom-level sensor: saves N(t) for all 4 dye levels over the reservoir; snap_interval in MEEP time units (1 unit = 3.336 fs)

snapshot_1._comment: Dense field snapshots ONLY over t=[0,80] MEEP units (dt=4 -> ~21 snaps) where the pulse actually arrives/peaks/decays (confirmed: prior dt=50 run showed peak intensity at the very first sample t=51, already down 4 orders of magnitude by t=100) -- nothing recorded in the long empty tail after that, keeps the npz well under 100 MB.
